title: Update prompt architecture and migration documentation
objective: Bring prompt module documentation in sync with the implemented parity architecture and remaining gaps.
context: Some existing prompt cache documentation is stale; for example, it describes zero active cache even though the current Anthropic provider has cache_control markers.
After the implementation tasks land, documentation should describe the real pipeline and explicitly list remaining non-parity areas.
deliverables: Update prompt/prompt_analysis.md with the current block pipeline, context injection, memory loader, and cache scope behavior.
Update prompt cache docs to remove stale zero-cache claims.
Document any intentional DeepSeek branding deviations from original Claude Code prose.
Document unsupported original features and link them to remaining tasks or rejected decisions.
Update architecture indexes that mention prompt module shape.
acceptance: Docs no longer contradict current code behavior.

Markdown renders cleanly enough for repository readers.
verification: ! rg -n "zero active cache|single-string|TODO|not implemented" prompt/*.md ARCHITECTURE.md MODULE_DEPENDENCIES.md

Do not remove historical notes unless they are misleading without context.
handoff_notes: Run this after the core P0 tasks land so the docs describe reality rather than aspiration.
